role: WatchSessionManager's pure helpers: how the iPhone's voice-chat reply reads on the Watch (refusal status line, state word) and how long a queued control request stays actionable (expiresAt stamping). Split out of WatchSessionManager.swift.
types: WatchSessionManager: extension — voice-chat reply wording and queued-request expiry
toplevel: Static constants only; main-actor by the Watch target's default isolation, as in WatchSessionManager.swift.

units.does: Refusal status for a voice-chat reply: nil unless ok == false and needsDisclaimer is not true; then the shared controlReplyStatus wording with empty success text.

branches.effect: false (accepted, ok missing, or disclaimer case): nil; true: controlReplyStatus wording

units.does: Maps the iPhone voice-chat token to a localized word; nil for idle or an unknown token, where callers supply their own resting word ("Off" here, "Talk to AI" on StartScreen). The one table for both.
Returns a copy of payload with expiresAt (seconds since 1970) = now + queuedStopLifetime (12 h) for an End (stopWorkoutFromWatch), else now + queuedRequestLifetime (60 s).
